messages:
sara: Quick recap from the All-Hands Q&A about hybrid/remote and travel. I'll answer the confirmed items now; flag anything else here. :spiral_note_pad:

noah: If a manager wants a recurring 'team day' in-office, do they need to publish it org-wide?

sara: Managers set team norms. Publish on your team calendar; if it affects other teams or shared spaces, notify your GM so we can coordinate.

pete: Any change to the commuting stipend pilots? I heard SF pilot was extended?

sara: Update: SF/CO commuter pilots are winding down this quarter. Were evaluating expansion to new regions. We will give 30 days notice prior to any change.

anya: For offsites, whats the policy on partner travel and childcare?

sara: For company-sponsored offsites were running a small childcare/partner stipend pilot for 2026. Details and eligibility will be on the travel page. Managers can request exceptions for critical contributors.

ops-bot: Reminder: submit travel requests at least 21 days in advance for domestic, 30 days for international.

noah: Visa letters? Who issues them?

sara: People Ops issues invitation/attendance letters for official events. Put a note in the travel form 'visa_support' and finance will reimburse pre-approved visa fees.

pete: Booking/process nit: is there a preferred vendor list for group flights/hotels?

sara: Yes  use the travel form vendor dropdown. If the vendors not listed, choose Other and tag procurement (cc: tom).

anya: ADA and accommodations? Confidential process?

sara: File a private request with People Ops and well handle accommodations confidentially.

noah: Who approves schedule exceptions (alternate dates, extra nights)?

sara: Operational exceptions = manager + People Ops. Budget exceptions escalate to Finance + GM.

ops-bot: Expense tip: use code EXP-OFFSITE-2026 for offsite charges to speed processing.

noah: Thanks  can we get a manager checklist for setting team in-office norms?

sara: Yes  I'll publish a short checklist and the updated FAQ by next Tue and ping eng-leads. DM me for private follow-up.

pete: Appreciate it  clears up a lot.
